body:
I am a 19 year old college student who purchased Oxiracetam from an online vendor. I have substantial experience with drugs ranging from A-Z , Thankfully not addicted to any, and I am currently studying Genetics and Cell Biology.
I have limited Experience with Nootropics; Namely Ginko biloba, Gotu Kola, Brahmi, Phosphatidyl Choline/Serine/Inositol/ethanolamine, Alpha GPC, Melatonin, 5-HTP & DMAE Bitartrate. This Racetam needs documenting. So here's my account.
Setting: My College Bedroom, Tuesday evening
Mindset: Little Tired, Quite Hungry, Moderately fatigued from a gym session earlier in the day.
My Parcel shipped from California and arrived earlier in the day Labelled:
Oxiracetam
Specification: 99%
Expiration Date: 03/2015
Weight: 100g
Sliver foil packet, tiny crystals similar to crushed up snow.
**Experience**
Time: 7:30 pm
[No Drugs previously taken in the last 24 hours]
0:00 Ingested 750mg Alpha GPC with 2500mg Oxiracetam (Weighed out using digital scales.) with some blackcurrant juice. I had not eaten in around 4 hours.
0:10 Not noticing anything obvious, I get my laundry together and gather some money, deciding to pick up dinner from the shop. The shop is located 10 minutes down the road and I decided to bring my Ipod to keep me company
0:37 Something strikes me. The Hue of colours seems greatly enhanced. Street lights, Cars, my own jumper[sweater], Like the exposure changing on a camera. This was a very nice change on a wet dim evening :)
1:08 I noticed while listening to my Ipod. Music seems more pleasant and striking. Images of scenes appear that I associate with every song. I was listening to Avashai Cohen - Remembering. The piano notes seemed to jump out of the song perfectly pitched and The Double bass seemed deeper and richer In quality.
2:10 I believe Oxiracetam has some subtle but evident Stimulant Properties. The ones I could pinpoint were...
Decreased hunger (the food I bought from the shop did not seem nearly as necessary as before I dosed)
My mood greatly improved, I became less irritable and the mind Fog I previously had condensed into a willingness to engage in mental activity.
3:00 I talked with house mates and was not stuck for input into their conversation as I usually am. I ate some food as I needed nutrients to recover from the Gym. Whenever pressed for information by my neighbours, I seemed to recollect better and without hesitating.
3:35 Finished my online assignment on Mastering Chemistry. Found it a pleasant experience. Positively challenging.
No additional effects precipitated so I decided to stop documenting.
Summary
I believe Oxiracetam is a very useful Nootropic. It had solely mental effects giving little if any hint of bodily effect when I ingested it. My senses seemed Sharpened mainly Visual and auditory. Visual memory greatly increased as well of Verbal. Concentration span was enormous.
The take home point I want to stress is that everything arising from this experience felt very natural as if it was already there. Very Promising...bring on the Summer Exams. :)
For me oxiracetam gets five stars and is in my opinion better than Ginko, DMAE, Alpha GPC, Gotu Kola and Brahmi all stacked!
